recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. If future changes to valueset-map are needed, make them in HL7/fhir-extensions; no FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5803.
issue_request: FHIR-5803 was a Published/Persuasive vocab change request for DSTU1 asking to add an extension so a ValueSet can reference a ConceptMap relevant to its interpretation.
initial_application: Jira cites svn revision 5718. Converted git commit 21cf46fda20485dc8e3b105b9b69a5d91da5548c added the ValueSet extension spreadsheet row named map, scoped to ValueSet, cardinality 0..1, with Reference(ConceptMap). Later source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 materialized it as source/valueset/structuredefinition-extension-valueset-map.xml.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed source/valueset/structuredefinition-extension-valueset-map.xml during the R5 extension migration. The current authoritative definition is in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-map.xml, with URL http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/valueset-map, context ValueSet, and a canonical value targeting ConceptMap. Later Applied issue FHIR-40705 clarified the same extension in the Extension Pack and is already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source change was made because re-adding the StructureDefinition to core would duplicate extension-pack ownership.
